rationale:
The requirement applies: `assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.workflow`.

The site meets the obligation. After the front matter and the H1 title, the file has a short prose intro paragraph. The first `##` section is `## Workflow`. `## Inventories`, `## Proposing requirements`, `## Tagging`, `## Report` and `## Gotchas` all come after it.

The `## Workflow` section is a list of steps numbered 1 to 9. Each is a checkbox item (`- [ ] 1.` through `- [ ] 9.`). The numbering and checkbox form make them ordered steps, with the order stated explicitly. The lead-in text says to run steps 1 to 3 once, repeat 4 to 7 per area, then do 8 and 9.

The intro paragraph under the H1 is not a section, so it does not open the file with another section.

The site shows no gap. No violation matches were listed for this site.
